messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty: service=inference-proxy | alert=high_95p_latency | region=us-west-2 | count=3 | severity=P2
alex: ACK. I'm on it.
mira: seeing the page too. jumping into dashboards — latency spike at ~1732109800, ~90s wide. no 5xxs in metrics.
raj: checking router traces now — lots of cold KV-cache hits + redis connection churn around the same time. looks like a warmup wobble.
alex: good call. any errors in logs? can we confirm no user requests failing?
mira: logs: small bursts of grpc backpressure logs, snippet: ```WARN backpressure: queue_len=128 target=64```
raj: support feed shows one chat mentioning slow responses but no errors. SLO burn looks negligible (<0.05% over 5m).
alex: okay — likely transient. I'll ACK the PD page and apply a short suppression window to avoid flapping. @carla, if this grows can you escalate to infra-lead?
carla: on standby. if it repeats >3 times in 10m escalate.
incidentbot: PagerDuty: alex acknowledged the alert (ACK). Auto-suppress scheduled for 8m.
mira: putting quick console note: "us-west-2 transient latency, probable KV warmup; watched 10m; no customer impact observed"
raj: also pushing a temporary config to increase KV prefill threshold on canaries (nonblocking rollout). snippet: ```curl -XPOST /admin/kv/prefill -d '{"prefill_pct":0.2}'```
alex: thumbs. monitor shows 30% drop in tail latency after the prefill push.
carla: marking this as auto-resolved if no additional pages in suppression window. any postmortem needed?
mira: not unless it repeats. will add a short runbook addendum about tuning prefill and suppression thresholds.
alex: noted. leaving a follow-up todo: review canary schedule + incidentbot hysteresis next week.
incidentbot: PagerDuty: alert resolved (auto-resolve) — last signal cleared.
raj: closing loop — no customer impact, mitigation applied, follow-up runbook item created.
carla: thanks team :thumbsup:
